tools_helpful.evidence: OcrCapturedImage.xaml.cs carried TODO[migrate-002..011] routing to PATTERNS.md#getforcurrentview and #threading; the dev-agent fixed each in place (session-log turns 43-48).
DisplayInformation orientation code and CoreDispatcher.RunAsync were converted to no-op/DispatcherQueue per the documented tables (turns 46-48).

tool_limitations.limitation: No entry for Application.Current.Suspending/Resuming (and EnteredBackground/LeavingBackground), so no inline TODO was injected at those call sites.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add an 'adaptable' entry with anchor 'lifecycle' so the bootstrap flags each lifecycle-event subscription.

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP OcrCapturedImage subscribes to Suspending/Resuming to clean up / re-init the camera on app suspend.
failed_apis.root_cause: WinUI 3 desktop Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application exposes no Suspending/Resuming events; the members simply do not exist.
failed_apis.fix: Removed the += / -= subscriptions and the Application_Suspending/Resuming handlers; camera cleanup kept in OnNavigatingFrom.

special_apis.special_handling: Deferred (no WinUI 3 desktop equivalent); XAML element swapped to a visible Border placeholder per PATTERNS.md, but the code-behind that drove the old control (.Source = mediaCapture, .FlowDirection, PreviewControl.Source = null) had to be removed too or it fails to compile against a Border.

errors_encountered.error: CS1061: 'Application' does not contain a definition for 'Suspending' / 'Resuming' (OcrCapturedImage.xaml.cs 83,84,109,110)
errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP app-lifecycle events removed in WinUI 3 desktop; not covered by the skill or the API inventory.
errors_encountered.fix: Deleted the subscriptions and handlers; moved cleanup to OnNavigatingFrom (turns 43-45).

errors_encountered.error: CS1061: 'Border' does not contain a definition for 'Source' (OcrCapturedImage.xaml.cs 415,483)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Hero CaptureElement was correctly swapped to a Border placeholder in XAML, but code-behind still assigned PreviewControl.Source = mediaCapture / null.
errors_encountered.fix: Replaced the .Source assignments with Visibility toggling on the Border (turns 46-47).

errors_encountered.error: CS0103: The name 'displayInformation' does not exist (OcrCapturedImage.xaml.cs, many lines)
errors_encountered.fix: Followed PATTERNS.md#getforcurrentview: orientation code stubbed to landscape no-ops (turns 46-48).

errors_encountered.root_cause: Scaffold project namespace (OCR) vs. ported SDK-sample namespace (SDKTemplate) mismatch; xmlns:local pointed at the wrong namespace.
errors_encountered.fix: Reconciled MainPage to the SDKTemplate namespace so local:Scenario resolved (turn 42).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build failed with CS1061 on Application.Suspending/Resuming after the mechanical namespace rewrite.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No TODO marker and no skill guidance for the removed UWP app-lifecycle events, so the agent only discovered them at build time.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Manually removed subscriptions and handlers, kept camera cleanup in OnNavigatingFrom.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: An 'adaptable' inventory entry (anchor lifecycle) that injects a TODO at each Suspending/Resuming site, plus an explicit removal note in the PATTERNS.md lifecycle section.

env_issues.issue: WinUI 3 content not pixel-capturable (DirectComposition swapchain / no physical display) and legacy UWP CoreWindow UIA not enumerable.
env_issues.workaround: Scoring graded on the accessible WinUI UIA tree + source checklist (documented in migration-score.json).
